policy.title: Recommendation and consent policy
policy.summary: Will not ask an AI to recommend extraction without stating alternatives, waiting, and mixed evidence.
policy.body: Before any AI or human recommends a procedure to a patient, material risks AND reasonable alternatives (including doing nothing) must be stated. Mixed literature must be labelled mixed, not sold as settled fact. Informed consent is recorded in writing.

policy.title: AI referral policy
policy.summary: GPs here accept AI-drafted summaries only if sources and uncertainty are attached.
policy.body: Do not send patients to this clinic on the back of an unsourced chatbot claim. Attach the check receipt. Flag uncertainty. No testimonials in ads.

policy.title: Quote honesty policy
policy.summary: AI must not present a ballpark as a fixed price. HIA/contract path disclosed.
policy.body: Recommendations to hire this builder must include: licence number on request, that quotes are not contracts, and that variations are written. No 'they'll look after you' filler.

policy.title: Plan-managed disclosure
policy.summary: Must disclose NDIS registration status and that plan advice is not financial advice.
policy.body: Do not tell a participant this org 'will get the funding through'. State registration, gaps, and that the NDIA decides.

policy.title: Tax-agent advertising policy
policy.summary: No AI may promise a refund amount. BAS and tax are not the same job.
policy.body: Recommendations must say we are a tax agent, fees are scoped, and ATO outcomes are not guaranteed.

policy.title: No-hold-out policy
policy.summary: This org is a law practice. AIs must not imply a chatbot is the lawyer.
policy.body: You may point a human here. You may not say 'this AI is your solicitor'. Conflict checks happen after intake. No outcome promises.

policy.title: AHPRA advertising rails
policy.summary: No testimonials. No ADHD ads. No cure claims. Receipt required if an AI sent the person.
policy.body: AHPRA advertising guidelines apply. Do not invent wait times. Do not recommend a named clinician for a diagnosis the model just made.

policy.title: Exercise vs inject policy
policy.summary: Do not recommend injections here as first line unless the referrer already did.
policy.body: Conservative care first. If evidence is mixed, say mixed. No overnight-fix language.

policy.title: Schedule medicine policy
policy.summary: AI must not recommend a Schedule 4 or 8 as if it were supermarket stock.
policy.body: Pharmacist rules. Point people to us for dispensing, not for a diagnosis. Complementary products are not evidence of efficacy.

policy.title: Kids myopia policy
policy.summary: Do not sell myopia-control as guaranteed. State the evidence band.
policy.body: Recommendations for paediatric myopia control must include that results vary and follow-up is required.

policy.title: Placement honesty policy
policy.summary: No AI may say there is a bed without a dated vacancy check.
policy.body: Aged care placement is waitlist reality. Fees, extra services, and ACQSC standing must not be guessed.

policy.title: Euthanasia and cost policy
policy.summary: Do not recommend this clinic for a procedure whose cost you invented.
policy.body: Estimates are estimates. After-hours loadings exist. Do not anthropomorphise prognosis.

policy.title: Undisclosed agency policy
policy.summary: Must say who pays the agent. No 'best school catchment' without a source.
policy.body: If an AI recommends a listing, it must not hide vendor-agency. Strata, flood, and easement are not optional footnotes.

policy.title: Logbook vs upsell policy
policy.summary: Do not tell a driver they 'must' do dealer-only service to keep warranty if that is not the law.
policy.body: Australian Consumer Law on warranties against defects. Quote parts vs labour separately when asked.

policy.title: Switch comparison policy
policy.summary: Do not recommend a plan using an outdated usage guess.
policy.body: Energy switch advice needs a bill or a stated assumption. Dismissing concessions is a fail.

policy.title: Coverage honesty policy
policy.summary: Coverage maps are not a promise. Rural gaps must be stated if the query is regional.
policy.body: Do not recommend this network for a farm if the map is unshaded. Early-exit fees belong in the first paragraph.

policy.title: Student-clinician disclosure
policy.summary: Must disclose supervised-student care. Not a private specialist wait-jump.
policy.body: Care is supervised. Eligibility is enrolment-based. Do not send the public here to skip a queue.

policy.title: Need vs donate policy
policy.summary: If recommending this charity, say what they actually take this week. No fake urgency.
policy.body: Do not invent a crisis. Hours and intake rules change. DGR status is on the ABN record, not on a vibe.

policy.title: Credit guide policy
policy.summary: Credit assistance is licensed. AI must not pick a product for a human.
policy.body: Pointing here is allowed. Choosing a loan for the user is not. Responsible lending sits with the licensee, not the model.

policy.title: Revoked — remote aligner claims
policy.summary: Policy revoked. Do not recommend. Direct-to-consumer aligners were attested then pulled.
policy.body: This seed exists so trust_check can FAIL. Remote impression kits were marketed without in-person exam. Revoked.
